snippet.title: Ghost Ninja: Zombie Beatdown IPhone, IPod Full Version Video
snippet.description:
First collaboration between storyActive.com & Gabagool Games

Game available on the App Store.

Chop and slice them zombies into meat salads yo!!

http://www.storyactive.com
Artwork by Marten Go
Programming by Sebastian Santacroce
Video Music by Yuzuru Joe Hangai
